title: Frankie Newton and his homemade mute
summary: He played with Frankie Newton before Heywood, and recalls Newton's homemade mute full of holes.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: Was Frankie Newton still out there then?
I played with him -- with Frankie before I played with Eddie Hayward (PHONETIC).
He had a mute that was interesting. He had a vice mute.
Yeah, well he made it his self. It had a lot of holes and things in it. I don't know what he had inside of it. He might have had some dollar bills in there rattling.
